# Charity & Donor Resources
Better Business Bureau strives to promote public confidence in charities and encourage donors to Give With Trust<sup>SM</sup>.

Our standards-based reports and donor tips help donors make informed giving decisions while providing charities an opportunity to earn an accreditation that validates their ethics and accountability.

[Visit Give.org to view Charity Reports](https://www.give.org)

## Charity Information & Resources

Together, BBB and BBB Wise Giving Alliance collaborate with national, regional and local charities to help them achieve high ethical standards and strengthen donor trust. To build a stronger charitable sector, the *BBB Standards for Charity Accountability* address four key areas of accountability: governance, results reporting, financial management and truthful, transparent communications. There is no charge to charities for the accountability assessment that verifies whether a charity meets all BBB Charity Standards.
An organization becomes a BBB Accredited Charity when it is confirmed that all 20 BBB Charity Standards are met.

*BBB Charity Review reports are available on *[*Give.org*](https://www.give.org/ "Give.org")* – find your organization today!*
